subject: Implementation

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: var is used extensively where the type is not apparent from the right-hand side, contrary to the repo's own .editorconfig settings
findings.recommendation: Either use explicit types for locals whose type isn't obvious from the call (matching the repo's .editorconfig csharp_style_var_* = false settings), or relax those .editorconfig rules to match actual practice so the configured style and the code agree.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: The IDbConnection and IDbTransaction created in TestingRepository are never wrapped in using/await using and can leak if an exception occurs before the inner try block
findings.recommendation: Wrap connection in a using/await using declaration (and transaction in its own using) instead of manually calling Close() in a finally block, so Dispose() always runs — including if connection.Open() or BeginTransaction() throws before the inner try/finally is reached.
